name: Ripple menu
description: A menu that spreads in rings from where you press and hold, right-click or tap its button, choosing the action you move toward.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; ring?: number; tone?: "default" | "destructive" }[]
props.description: The actions, commonest first. Without ring, up to five go on the inner ring and the rest on the outer one; ring 0, 1 or 2 places one by hand.

props.name: onAction
props.type: (id: string, point: { x: number; y: number }) => void
props.description: Called when an action is chosen, with the press point relative to the area, so it can act on that spot.

props.name: children
props.description: The target area, such as a map. The wrapper is relative and takes className; it does not pan by touch, so the press can be held.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu for assistive technology.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Shows a round button in the bottom corner that opens the menu around itself. It is also the keyboard way in, along with Shift+F10.

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: Milliseconds to press and hold before the menu opens. Moving more than 8 pixels first cancels it.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Leaves the area alone and disables the button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the area. The wrapper has data-open while its menu is open.
